authority_boundary: This register identifies Codex-Guidas assurance assets and proposed review triggers. It does not authorize changes in other repositories, certify compliance, close project gates, or convert inventory review into an audit.

risk_tiers.critical: Credible severe safety, security, privacy or data-integrity exposure, active exploitation, or highly irreversible consequence.
risk_tiers.high: Material user, service, security or integrity consequence with significant exposure or limited mitigation.
risk_tiers.moderate: Meaningful governance, integrity or operational consequence, but bounded scope and plausible recovery/containment.
risk_tiers.low: Limited consequence and exposure with straightforward recovery.
risk_tiers.unassessed: Insufficient evidence to assign a defensible tier.

evidence.scope: Read-only inspection of the current feature-branch tree and selected assurance, invariant, methodology, pack and CI files to identify assurance assets and proposed review triggers.
evidence.limitation: Inventory evidence only; not an exhaustive source audit, security assessment, GitHub settings verification, runtime test or independent review. The branch remains a draft PR.

audit_assets.name: Knowledge-tooling and CI pipeline
audit_assets.decision_authority_role: Repository owner for Codex-Guidas changes only
audit_assets.risk_rationale: Provisional judgement: these scripts and workflows validate and retrieve engineering knowledge; a defect can create false confidence or suppress diagnostics. The repository is public, but this is not itself a production deployment pipeline.

change_triggers.action: Review validator/search behavior, regression coverage, failure handling and index consistency.
Review trigger permissions, pinned action provenance, runner/runtime compatibility and exact-head CI behavior.

limitations: No repository settings, branch-protection rules, secrets configuration, runner administration or external integrations were verified.

audit_assets.name: Evidence lifecycle, lesson records and defect intelligence
audit_assets.decision_authority_role: Repository owner for knowledge-base status; owning project retains project-specific control and closure authority
audit_assets.risk_rationale: Provisional judgement: incorrect evidence classification, lesson promotion or defect closure could mislead downstream project decisions. Current records preserve uncertainty and project authority boundaries, but operational effectiveness is not measured.

change_triggers.action: Review taxonomy/schema compatibility, evidence promotion rules, validator behavior and migration implications.
Review material status changes, provenance, defect lifecycle completeness and unresolved/overdue verification.

limitations: The metadata validator cannot prove source truth, reviewer identity or competence, delegated authority, project implementation or recurrence reduction.

audit_assets.name: Methodologies, invariants and 33-framework lineage
audit_assets.decision_authority_role: Repository owner for Codex-Guidas doctrine; each adopting project retains local design and release authority
audit_assets.risk_rationale: Provisional judgement: these documents shape review methods and may be reused across projects. Misstated maturity, duplicated lineage or unbounded application could create false assurance or unnecessary process burden.

change_triggers.action: Review claim maturity, evidence requirements, invariants, framework lineage/crosswalk and explicit validation limitations.

limitations: This register does not certify the frameworks, specify all 33 tiers, validate every lens or authorize adoption by another project.

audit_assets.name: Reusable knowledge packs and adoption records
audit_assets.decision_authority_role: Repository owner for upstream pack content; receiving project owner for local adoption
audit_assets.risk_rationale: Provisional judgement: a copied pack can transfer useful safeguards but can also transfer unsuitable assumptions, stale controls or licensing confusion. Each receiving project must revalidate local applicability and rights.

change_triggers.action: Review manifest, version/changelog alignment, maturity labels, upstream provenance, adoption guidance and licensing boundary.

limitations: No external reuse licence is declared; no downstream adoption or control effectiveness is inferred from pack availability.
